reviews.body: Codzee left 4 comments below — overview in the summary comment.

review_comments.body:
🔶 **Hardening** | Major

**Any non-empty admin token enables key minting.** adminRoutes enables the rotate endpoint for any non-empty ADMIN_TOKEN, such as `x`, with no minimum length and no throttling on a `public: true` route. A guessed token mints a working API key for any tenant whose id is known, which is a full tenant takeover. Reject short tokens at startup (for example under 32 characters) and rate-limit failed attempts. The 14-character token in test/admin.test.ts would need lengthening.

<details><summary>🤖 Fix with AI</summary>

```text
Fix this code review finding in GauravChopada/ledgerline, pull request 7. The line number is from commit c1a4109; if the file has changed since, find the same code.

[Major] Any non-empty admin token enables key minting — src/routes/admin.ts:17
adminRoutes enables the rotate endpoint for any non-empty ADMIN_TOKEN, such as `x`, with no minimum length and no throttling on a `public: true` route. A guessed token mints a working API key for any tenant whose id is known, which is a full tenant takeover. Reject short tokens at startup (for example under 32 characters) and rate-limit failed attempts. The 14-character token in test/admin.test.ts would need lengthening.

Read the code at the location first and confirm the problem. Make the smallest change that fixes it, without changing unrelated code or existing behaviour. Add or update a test that would have caught it. If you think it is not a real problem, say why instead of changing the code.
```

</details>

🟡 **Test gap** | Minor

**Method filter test misses multi-value path.** The 'filters payments by method' test only asserts `items.length === 2` for `?method=cash`. It never checks that the returned rows are cash, and it never runs the `?method=cash&method=card` array branch. It also never covers a rejected value such as `?method=foo`, which now returns 400 where it used to be ignored. A broken IN-list for two methods would ship green.

<details><summary>🤖 Fix with AI</summary>

```text
Fix this code review finding in GauravChopada/ledgerline, pull request 7. The line number is from commit c1a4109; if the file has changed since, find the same code.

[Minor · missing test] Method filter test misses multi-value path — test/payments.test.ts:80
The 'filters payments by method' test only asserts `items.length === 2` for `?method=cash`. It never checks that the returned rows are cash, and it never runs the `?method=cash&method=card` array branch. It also never covers a rejected value such as `?method=foo`, which now returns 400 where it used to be ignored. A broken IN-list for two methods would ship green.

Read the code at the location first and confirm the problem. Make the smallest change that fixes it, without changing unrelated code or existing behaviour. Add or update a test that would have caught it. If you think it is not a real problem, say why instead of changing the code.
```

</details>

🟡 **Test gap** | Minor

**Rotation scope and 404 path untested.** The rotation test uses one tenant, so nothing checks that rotating Acme leaves another tenant's key working. That is the only thing the `tenant_id = ?` filter in the revoke UPDATE protects. The unknown-tenant 404 path and a wrong or missing admin token are also untested, because the auth test only sends a tenant key. Add a second tenant, then assert its key still returns 200 and an unknown id returns 404.

<details><summary>🤖 Fix with AI</summary>

```text
Fix this code review finding in GauravChopada/ledgerline, pull request 7. The line number is from commit c1a4109; if the file has changed since, find the same code.

[Minor · missing test] Rotation scope and 404 path untested — test/admin.test.ts:29
The rotation test uses one tenant, so nothing checks that rotating Acme leaves another tenant's key working. That is the only thing the `tenant_id = ?` filter in the revoke UPDATE protects. The unknown-tenant 404 path and a wrong or missing admin token are also untested, because the auth test only sends a tenant key. Add a second tenant, then assert its key still returns 200 and an unknown id returns 404.

Read the code at the location first and confirm the problem. Make the smallest change that fixes it, without changing unrelated code or existing behaviour. Add or update a test that would have caught it. If you think it is not a real problem, say why instead of changing the code.
```

</details>
Agreed on length and throttling. Is the token comparison on the next line itself OK as written?

No, that's also worth fixing. `header !== \`Bearer ${adminToken}\`` is a plain string comparison, which is vulnerable to timing attacks — an attacker can recover the token byte-by-byte by measuring response time. Use a constant-time comparison like `crypto.timingSafeEqual` (with length-padding/hashing both sides first, since it throws on mismatched lengths).

output.title: 4 findings · 2 major · not blocking (merge gate: Critical)
output.summary: Adds an admin API protected by a shared ADMIN_TOKEN secret with a POST /admin/tenants/:tenantId/api-keys/rotate endpoint to revoke a tenant's old API key and issue a new one, wiring adminToken through app config/env and registering the new admin routes; also adds a method filter (single or multiple values) to the GET /payments list endpoint. Includes tests for admin key rotation/auth and payment method filtering.
